# Authentication

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 implicit authentication

    - Flow: implicit
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform|See, edit, configure, and delete your Google Cloud data and see the email address for your Google Account.|

- oAuth2 authentication. Oauth 2.0 authorizationCode authentication

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth)
    - Token URL = [https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform|See, edit, configure, and delete your Google Cloud data and see the email address for your Google Account.|

<h1 id="application-integration-api-callback">callback</h1>

## integrations.callback.generateToken

<a id="opIdintegrations.callback.generateToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/callback:generateToken \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /v1/callback:generateToken`

Receives the auth code and auth config id to combine that with the client id and secret to retrieve access tokens from the token endpoint. Returns either a success or error message when it's done.

<h3 id="integrationscallbackgeneratetoken-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|query|string|false|The auth code for the given request|
|gcpProjectId|query|string|false|The gcp project id of the request|
|product|query|string|false|Which product sends the request|
|redirectUri|query|string|false|Redirect uri of the auth code request|
|state|query|string|false|The auth config id for the given request|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|product|UNSPECIFIED_PRODUCT|
|product|IP|
|product|APIGEE|
|product|SECURITY|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "message": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="integrationscallbackgeneratetoken-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaGenerateTokenResponse](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphageneratetokenresponse)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
Oauth2 ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform ) & Oauth2c ( Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform )
</aside>

<h1 id="application-integration-api-projects">projects</h1>

## integrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.takeoverEditLock

<a id="opIdintegrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.takeoverEditLock"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/string:takeoverEditLock \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{}'
```

`POST /v1/{integrationVersion}:takeoverEditLock`

Clears the `locked_by` and `locked_at_timestamp`in the DRAFT version of this integration. It then performs the same action as the CreateDraftIntegrationVersion (i.e., copies the DRAFT version of the integration as a SNAPSHOT and then creates a new DRAFT version with the `locked_by` set to the `user_taking_over` and the `locked_at_timestamp` set to the current timestamp). Both the `locked_by` and `user_taking_over` are notified via email about the takeover. This RPC throws an exception if the integration is not in DRAFT status or if the `locked_by` and `locked_at_timestamp` fields are not set.The TakeoverEdit lock is treated the same as an edit of the integration, and hence shares ACLs with edit. Audit fields updated include last_modified_timestamp, last_modified_by.

> Body parameter

```json
{}
```

<h3 id="integrationsprojectslocationsproductsintegrationsversionstakeovereditlock-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationVersion|path|string|true|Required. The version to take over edit lock. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/integrations/{integration}/versions/{version}|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaTakeoverEditLockRequest](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphatakeovereditlockrequest)|false|none|

`POST /v1/{name}:execute`

Executes integrations synchronously by passing the trigger id in the request body. The request is not returned until the requested executions are either fulfilled or experienced an error. If the integration name is not specified (passing `-`), all of the associated integration under the given trigger_id will be executed. Otherwise only the specified integration for the given `trigger_id` is executed. This is helpful for execution the integration from UI.

`POST /v1/{name}:lift`

* Lifts suspension for advanced suspension task. Fetch corresponding suspension with provided suspension Id, resolve suspension, and set up suspension result for the Suspension Task.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "suspensionResult": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="integrationsprojectslocationsproductsintegrationsexecutionssuspensionslift-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Required. The resource that the suspension belongs to. "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/products/{product}/integrations/{integration}/executions/{execution}/suspensions/{suspenion}" format.|

`POST /v1/{name}:publish`

This RPC throws an exception if the integration is in ARCHIVED or ACTIVE state. This RPC throws an exception if the version being published is DRAFT, and if the `locked_by` user is not the same as the user performing the Publish. Audit fields updated include last_published_timestamp, last_published_by, last_modified_timestamp, last_modified_by. Any existing lock is on this integration is released.

```json
{}
```

## integrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.unpublish

<a id="opIdintegrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.unpublish"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/string:unpublish \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{}'
```

`POST /v1/{name}:unpublish`

Sets the status of the ACTIVE integration to SNAPSHOT with a new tag "PREVIOUSLY_PUBLISHED" after validating it. The "HEAD" and "PUBLISH_REQUESTED" tags do not change. This RPC throws an exception if the version being snapshot is not ACTIVE. Audit fields added include action, action_by, action_timestamp.

> Body parameter

```json
{}
```

`POST /v1/{parent}/authConfigs`

Creates an auth config record. Fetch corresponding credentials for specific auth types, e.g. access token for OAuth 2.0, JWT token for JWT. Encrypt the auth config with Cloud KMS and store the encrypted credentials in Spanner. Returns the encrypted auth config.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "certificateId": "string",
  "creatorEmail": "string",
  "credentialType": "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "decryptedCredential": {
```

`GET /v1/{parent}/connections`

Lists Connections in a given project and location.

## integrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.executions.list

<a id="opIdintegrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.executions.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/string/executions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /v1/{parent}/executions`

Lists the results of all the integration executions. The response includes the same information as the [execution log](https://cloud.google.com/application-integration/docs/viewing-logs) in the Integration UI.

<h3 id="integrationsprojectslocationsproductsintegrationsexecutionslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|parent|path|string|true|Required. The parent resource name of the integration execution.|
|filter|query|string|false|Optional. Standard filter field, we support filtering on following fields: workflow_name: the name of the integration. CreateTimestamp: the execution created time. event_execution_state: the state of the executions. execution_id: the id of the execution. trigger_id: the id of the trigger. parameter_type: the type of the parameters involved in the execution. All fields support for EQUALS, in additional: CreateTimestamp support for LESS_THAN, GREATER_THAN ParameterType support for HAS For example: "parameter_type" HAS \"string\" Also supports operators like AND, OR, NOT For example, trigger_id=\"id1\" AND workflow_name=\"testWorkflow\"|
|filterParams.customFilter|query|string|false|Optional user-provided custom filter.|
|filterParams.endTime|query|string|false|End timestamp.|
|filterParams.eventStatuses|query|[string]|false|List of possible event statuses.|
|filterParams.executionId|query|string|false|Execution id.|
|filterParams.parameterKey|query|string|false|Param key. DEPRECATED. User parameter_pair_key instead.|
|filterParams.parameterPairKey|query|string|false|Param key in the key value pair filter.|
|filterParams.parameterPairValue|query|string|false|Param value in the key value pair filter.|
|filterParams.parameterType|query|string|false|Param type.|
|filterParams.parameterValue|query|string|false|Param value. DEPRECATED. User parameter_pair_value instead.|
|filterParams.startTime|query|string|false|Start timestamp.|
|filterParams.taskStatuses|query|[string]|false|List of possible task statuses.|
|filterParams.workflowName|query|string|false|Workflow name.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Optional. The results would be returned in order you specified here. Currently supporting "last_modified_time" and "create_time".|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Optional. The size of entries in the response.|
|pageToken|query|string|false|Optional. The token returned in the previous response.|
|readMask|query|string|false|Optional. View mask for the response data. If set, only the field specified will be returned as part of the result. If not set, all fields in event execution info will be filled and returned.|
|refreshAcl|query|boolean|false|Optional. If true, the service will use the most recent acl information to list event execution infos and renew the acl cache. Note that fetching the most recent acl is synchronous, so it will increase RPC call latency.|
|truncateParams|query|boolean|false|Optional. If true, the service will truncate the params to only keep the first 1000 characters of string params and empty the executions in order to make response smaller. Only works for UI and when the params fields are not filtered out.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|

## integrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.list

<a id="opIdintegrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/string/versions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /v1/{parent}/versions`

Returns the list of all integration versions in the specified project.

<h3 id="integrationsprojectslocationsproductsintegrationsversionslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|parent|path|string|true|Required. The parent resource where this version will be created. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/integrations/{integration} Specifically, when parent equals: 1. projects//locations//integrations/, Meaning: "List versions (with filter) for a particular integration". 2. projects//locations//integrations/- Meaning: "List versions (with filter) for a client within a particular region". 3. projects//locations/-/integrations/- Meaning: "List versions (with filter) for a client".|
|fieldMask|query|string|false|The field mask which specifies the particular data to be returned.|
|filter|query|string|false|Filter on fields of IntegrationVersion. Fields can be compared with literal values by use of ":" (containment), "=" (equality), ">" (greater), "<" (less than), >=" (greater than or equal to), "<=" (less than or equal to), and "!=" (inequality) operators. Negation, conjunction, and disjunction are written using NOT, AND, and OR keywords. For example, organization_id=\"1\" AND state=ACTIVE AND description:"test". Filtering cannot be performed on repeated fields like `task_config`.|
|orderBy|query|string|false|The results would be returned in order you specified here. Currently supported sort keys are: Descending sort order for "last_modified_time", "created_time", "snapshot_number" Ascending sort order for "name".|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of versions to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 versions will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.|
|pageToken|query|string|false|A page token, received from a previous `ListIntegrationVersions` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListIntegrationVersions` must match the call that provided the page token.|

|newIntegration|query|boolean|false|Set this flag to true, if draft version is to be created for a brand new integration. False, if the request is for an existing integration. For backward compatibility reasons, even if this flag is set to `false` and no existing integration is found, a new draft integration will still be created.|

|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|

|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

|» databasePersistencePolicy|body|string|false|Optional. Flag to disable database persistence for execution data, including event execution info, execution export info, execution metadata index and execution param index.|
|» description|body|string|false|Optional. The integration description.|
|» errorCatcherConfigs|body|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaErrorCatcherConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaerrorcatcherconfig)]|false|Optional. Error Catch Task configuration for the integration. It's optional.|
|» integrationParameters|body|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationParameter](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationparameter)]|false|Optional. Parameters that are expected to be passed to the integration when an event is triggered. This consists of all the parameters that are expected in the integration execution. This gives the user the ability to provide default values, add information like PII and also provide data types of each parameter.|
|» integrationParametersInternal|body|[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoWorkflowParameters](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoworkflowparameters)|false|Optional. Parameters that are expected to be passed to the integration when an event is triggered. This consists of all the parameters that are expected in the integration execution. This gives the user the ability to provide default values, add information like PII and also provide data types of each parameter.|
|» lastModifierEmail|body|string|false|Optional. The last modifier's email address. Generated based on the End User Credentials/LOAS role of the user making the call.|
|» lockHolder|body|string|false|Optional. The edit lock holder's email address. Generated based on the End User Credentials/LOAS role of the user making the call.|
|» origin|body|string|false|Optional. The origin that indicates where this integration is coming from.|
|» parentTemplateId|body|string|false|Optional. The id of the template which was used to create this integration_version.|
|» runAsServiceAccount|body|string|false|Optional. The run-as service account email, if set and auth config is not configured, that will be used to generate auth token to be used in Connector task, Rest caller task and Cloud function task.|
|» snapshotNumber|body|string(int64)|false|Optional. An increasing sequence that is set when a new snapshot is created. The last created snapshot can be identified by [workflow_name, org_id latest(snapshot_number)]. However, last created snapshot need not be same as the HEAD. So users should always use "HEAD" tag to identify the head.|
|» taskConfigs|body|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaTaskConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphataskconfig)]|false|Optional. Task configuration for the integration. It's optional, but the integration doesn't do anything without task_configs.|
|» taskConfigsInternal|body|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoTaskConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprototaskconfig)]|false|Optional. Task configuration for the integration. It's optional, but the integration doesn't do anything without task_configs.|
|» teardown|body|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoTeardown](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprototeardown)|false|Optional. Contains a graph of tasks that will be executed before putting the event in a terminal state (SUCCEEDED/FAILED/FATAL), regardless of success or failure, similar to "finally" in code.|
|» triggerConfigs|body|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaTriggerConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphatriggerconfig)]|false|Optional. Trigger configurations.|
|» triggerConfigsInternal|body|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoTriggerConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprototriggerconfig)]|false|Optional. Trigger configurations.|
|» userLabel|body|string|false|Optional. A user-defined label that annotates an integration version. Typically, this is only set when the integration version is created.|

## integrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.upload

<a id="opIdintegrations.projects.locations.products.integrations.versions.upload"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://www.googleapis.com/v1/string/versions:upload \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "content": "string",
    "fileFormat": "FILE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/{parent}/versions:upload`

Uploads an integration. The content can be a previously downloaded integration. Performs the same function as CreateDraftIntegrationVersion, but accepts input in a string format, which holds the complete representation of the IntegrationVersion content.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "content": "string",
  "fileFormat": "FILE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED"
}
```

<h3 id="integrationsprojectslocationsproductsintegrationsversionsupload-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|parent|path|string|true|Required. The version to upload. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/integrations/{integration}|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|

|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaUploadIntegrationVersionRequest](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphauploadintegrationversionrequest)|false|none|
|» content|body|string|false|The textproto of the integration_version.|

<h2 id="tocS_EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigThresholdValue">EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigThresholdValue</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigthresholdvalue"></a>
<a id="schema_EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigThresholdValue"></a>
<a id="tocSenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigthresholdvalue"></a>
<a id="tocsenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigthresholdvalue"></a>

```json
{
  "absolute": "string",
  "percentage": 0
}
```

The threshold value of the metric, above or below which the alert should be triggered. See EventAlertConfig or TaskAlertConfig for the different alert metric types in each case. For the *RATE metrics, one or both of these fields may be set. Zero is the default value and can be left at that. For *PERCENTILE_DURATION metrics, one or both of these fields may be set, and also, the duration threshold value should be specified in the threshold_duration_ms member below. For *AVERAGE_DURATION metrics, these fields should not be set at all. A different member, threshold_duration_ms, must be set in the EventAlertConfig or the TaskAlertConfig.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|absolute|string(int64)|false|none|none|
|percentage|integer(int32)|false|none|none|

Policy that defines the task retry logic and failure type. If no FailurePolicy is defined for a task, all its dependent tasks will not be executed (i.e, a `retry_strategy` of NONE will be applied).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|intervalInSeconds|string(int64)|false|none|Required if retry_strategy is FIXED_INTERVAL or LINEAR/EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF/RESTART_WORKFLOW_WITH_BACKOFF. Defines the initial interval for backoff.|
|maxNumRetries|integer(int32)|false|none|Required if retry_strategy is FIXED_INTERVAL or LINEAR/EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF/RESTART_WORKFLOW_WITH_BACKOFF. Defines the number of times the task will be retried if failed.|
|retryStrategy|string|false|none|Defines what happens to the task upon failure.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|retryStrategy|UNSPECIFIED|
|retryStrategy|IGNORE|
|retryStrategy|NONE|
|retryStrategy|FATAL|
|retryStrategy|FIXED_INTERVAL|
|retryStrategy|LINEAR_BACKOFF|
|retryStrategy|EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF|
|retryStrategy|RESTART_WORKFLOW_WITH_BACKOFF|

|fieldType|string|false|none|Specifies the data type of the field.|
|protoDefPath|string|false|none|Optional. The fully qualified proto name (e.g. enterprise.crm.storage.Account). Required for output field of type PROTO_VALUE or PROTO_ARRAY. For e.g., if input field_type is BYTES and output field_type is PROTO_VALUE, then fully qualified proto type url should be provided to parse the input bytes. If field_type is *_ARRAY, then all the converted protos are of the same type.|
|referenceKey|string|false|none|This holds the reference key of the workflow or task parameter. 1. Any workflow parameter, for e.g. $workflowParam1$. 2. Any task input or output parameter, for e.g. $task1_param1$. 3. Any workflow or task parameters with subfield references, for e.g., $task1_param1.employee.id$|
|transformExpression|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoTransformExpression](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprototransformexpression)|false|none|This is the transform expression to fetch the input field value. for e.g. $param1$.CONCAT('test'). Keep points - 1. Only input field can have a transform expression. 2. If a transform expression is provided, reference_key will be ignored. 3. If no value is returned after evaluation of transform expression, default_value can be mapped if provided. 4. The field_type should be the type of the final object returned after the transform expression is evaluated. Scrubs the transform expression before logging as value provided by user so may or may not contain PII or SPII data.|

Message to be used to configure alerting in the {@code TaskConfig} protos for tasks in an event.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|aggregationPeriod|string|false|none|The period over which the metric value should be aggregated and evaluated. Format is , where integer should be a positive integer and unit should be one of (s,m,h,d,w) meaning (second, minute, hour, day, week).|
|alertDisabled|boolean|false|none|Set to false by default. When set to true, the metrics are not aggregated or pushed to Monarch for this workflow alert.|
|alertName|string|false|none|A name to identify this alert. This will be displayed in the alert subject. If set, this name should be unique in within the scope of the containing workflow.|
|clientId|string|false|none|Client associated with this alert configuration. Must be a client enabled in one of the containing workflow's triggers.|
|durationThresholdMs|string(int64)|false|none|Should be specified only for TASK_AVERAGE_DURATION and TASK_PERCENTILE_DURATION metrics. This member should be used to specify what duration value the metrics should exceed for the alert to trigger.|
|errorEnumList|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigErrorEnumList](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigerrorenumlist)|false|none|List of error enums for alerts.|
|metricType|string|false|none|none|
|numAggregationPeriods|integer(int32)|false|none|For how many contiguous aggregation periods should the expected min or max be violated for the alert to be fired.|
|onlyFinalAttempt|boolean|false|none|Only count final task attempts, not retries.|
|playbookUrl|string|false|none|Link to a playbook for resolving the issue that triggered this alert.|
|thresholdType|string|false|none|The threshold type for which this alert is being configured. If value falls below expected_min or exceeds expected_max, an alert will be fired.|
|thresholdValue|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigThresholdValue](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigthresholdvalue)|false|none|The metric value, above or below which the alert should be triggered.|
|warningEnumList|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigErrorEnumList](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigerrorenumlist)|false|none|List of error enums for alerts.|

|description|string|false|none|In a few sentences, describe the purpose and usage of the task.|
|descriptiveName|string|false|none|The string name to show on the task list on the Workflow editor screen. This should be a very short, one to two words name for the task. (e.g. "Send Mail")|

|isDeprecated|boolean|false|none|The deprecation status of the current task. Default value is false;|
|name|string|false|none|The actual class name or the annotated name of the task. Task Author should initialize this field with value from the getName() method of the Task class.|
|standaloneExternalDocHtml|string|false|none|External-facing documention for standalone IP in pantheon embedded in the RHP for this task. Non null only if different from external_doc_html|

Admins are owners of a Task, and have all permissions on a particular task identified by the task name. By default, Eventbus periodically scans all task metadata and syncs (adds) any new admins defined here to Zanzibar.

|googleGroupEmail|string|false|none|none|
|userEmail|string|false|none|none|

Message to be used to configure custom alerting in the {@code EventConfig} protos for an event.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|aggregationPeriod|string|false|none|For an EXPECTED_MIN threshold, this aggregation_period must be lesser than 24 hours.|
|alertDisabled|boolean|false|none|Set to false by default. When set to true, the metrics are not aggregated or pushed to Monarch for this workflow alert.|
|alertName|string|false|none|A name to identify this alert. This will be displayed in the alert subject. If set, this name should be unique within the scope of the workflow.|
|clientId|string|false|none|Client associated with this alert configuration.|
|durationThresholdMs|string(int64)|false|none|Should be specified only for *AVERAGE_DURATION and *PERCENTILE_DURATION metrics. This member should be used to specify what duration value the metrics should exceed for the alert to trigger.|
|errorEnumList|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigErrorEnumList](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigerrorenumlist)|false|none|List of error enums for alerts.|
|metricType|string|false|none|none|
|numAggregationPeriods|integer(int32)|false|none|For how many contiguous aggregation periods should the expected min or max be violated for the alert to be fired.|
|onlyFinalAttempt|boolean|false|none|For either events or tasks, depending on the type of alert, count only final attempts, not retries.|
|playbookUrl|string|false|none|Link to a playbook for resolving the issue that triggered this alert.|
|thresholdType|string|false|none|The threshold type, whether lower(expected_min) or upper(expected_max), for which this alert is being configured. If value falls below expected_min or exceeds expected_max, an alert will be fired.|
|thresholdValue|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigThresholdValue](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigthresholdvalue)|false|none|The metric value, above or below which the alert should be triggered.|
|warningEnumList|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoBaseAlertConfigErrorEnumList](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotobasealertconfigerrorenumlist)|false|none|List of error enums for alerts.|

|metricType|EVENT_RATE|

|eventExecutionInfoId|string|false|none|Auto-generated primary key.|

|product|string|false|none|Which Google product the execution_info belongs to. If not set, the execution_info belongs to Integration Platform by default.|

|workflowName|string|false|none|Name of the workflow.|

The task configuration details. This is not the implementation of Task. There might be multiple TaskConfigs for the same Task.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alertConfigs|[[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoTaskAlertConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprototaskalertconfig)]|false|none|Alert configurations on error rate, warning rate, number of runs, durations, etc.|
|createTime|string(google-datetime)|false|none|Auto-generated.|
|creatorEmail|string|false|none|The creator's email address. Auto-generated from the user's email.|
|description|string|false|none|User-provided description intended to give more business context about the task.|
|disableStrictTypeValidation|boolean|false|none|If this config contains a TypedTask, allow validation to succeed if an input is read from the output of another TypedTask whose output type is declared as a superclass of the requested input type. For instance, if the previous task declares an output of type Message, any task with this flag enabled will pass validation when attempting to read any proto Message type from the resultant Event parameter.|
|errorCatcherId|string|false|none|Optional Error catcher id of the error catch flow which will be executed when execution error happens in the task|
|externalTaskType|string|false|none|none|
|failurePolicy|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoFailurePolicy](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotofailurepolicy)|false|none|Optional. Determines the number of times the task will be retried on failure and with what retry strategy. This is applicable for asynchronous calls to Eventbus alone (Post To Queue, Schedule etc.).|
|incomingEdgeCount|integer(int32)|false|none|The number of edges leading into this TaskConfig.|
|jsonValidationOption|string|false|none|If set, overrides the option configured in the Task implementation class.|
|label|string|false|none|User-provided label that is attached to this TaskConfig in the UI.|
|lastModifiedTime|string(google-datetime)|false|none|Auto-generated.|
|nextTasks|[[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoNextTask](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotonexttask)]|false|none|The set of tasks that are next in line to be executed as per the execution graph defined for the parent event, specified by `event_config_id`. Each of these next tasks are executed only if the condition associated with them evaluates to true.|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|string|false|none|The policy dictating the execution of the next set of tasks for the current task.|
|parameters|object|false|none|The customized parameters the user can pass to this task.|
|position|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoCoordinate](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotocoordinate)|false|none|Optional. Informs the front-end application where to draw this task config on the UI.|
|precondition|string|false|none|Optional. Standard filter expression evaluated before execution. Independent of other conditions and tasks. Can be used to enable rollout. e.g. "rollout(5)" will only allow 5% of incoming traffic to task.|
|preconditionLabel|string|false|none|Optional. User-provided label that is attached to precondition in the UI.|
|rollbackStrategy|[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoRollbackStrategy](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotorollbackstrategy)|false|none|Optional. Contains information about what needs to be done upon failure (either a permanent error or after it has been retried too many times).|
|successPolicy|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoSuccessPolicy](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotosuccesspolicy)|false|none|Determines what action to take upon successful task completion.|
|synchronousCallFailurePolicy|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoFailurePolicy](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotofailurepolicy)|false|none|Optional. Determines the number of times the task will be retried on failure and with what retry strategy. This is applicable for synchronous calls to Eventbus alone (Post).|
|taskEntity|[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoTaskEntity](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprototaskentity)|false|none|Copy of the task entity that this task config is an instance of.|
|taskExecutionStrategy|string|false|none|The policy dictating the execution strategy of this task.|
|taskName|string|false|none|The name for the task.|
|taskNumber|string|false|none|REQUIRED: the identifier of this task within its parent event config, specified by the client. This should be unique among all the tasks belong to the same event config. We use this field as the identifier to find next tasks (via field `next_tasks.task_number`).|
|taskSpec|string|false|none|A string template that allows user to configure task parameters (with either literal default values or tokens which will be resolved at execution time) for the task. It will eventually replace the old "parameters" field.|
|taskTemplateName|string|false|none|Used to define task-template name if task is of type task-template|
|taskType|string|false|none|Defines the type of the task|

Configuration detail of a trigger. Next available id: 19

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alertConfig|[[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoWorkflowAlertConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotoworkflowalertconfig)]|false|none|An alert threshold configuration for the [trigger + client + workflow] tuple. If these values are not specified in the trigger config, default values will be populated by the system. Note that there must be exactly one alert threshold configured per [client + trigger + workflow] when published.|
|cloudSchedulerConfig|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoCloudSchedulerConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotocloudschedulerconfig)|false|none|Cloud Scheduler Trigger configuration|
|description|string|false|none|User-provided description intended to give more business context about the task.|
|enabledClients|[string]|false|none|Required. The list of client ids which are enabled to execute the workflow using this trigger. In other words, these clients have the workflow execution privledges for this trigger. For API trigger, the client id in the incoming request is validated against the list of enabled clients. For non-API triggers, one workflow execution is triggered on behalf of each enabled client.|
|errorCatcherId|string|false|none|Optional Error catcher id of the error catch flow which will be executed when execution error happens in the task|
|label|string|false|none|The user created label for a particular trigger.|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|string|false|none|Dictates how next tasks will be executed.|
|pauseWorkflowExecutions|boolean|false|none|Optional. If set to true, any upcoming requests for this trigger config will be paused and the executions will be resumed later when the flag is reset. The workflow to which this trigger config belongs has to be in ACTIVE status for the executions to be paused or resumed.|
|position|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoCoordinate](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotocoordinate)|false|none|Optional. Informs the front-end application where to draw this trigger config on the UI.|
|properties|object|false|none|Configurable properties of the trigger, not to be confused with workflow parameters. E.g. "name" is a property for API triggers and "subscription" is a property for Cloud Pubsub triggers.|
|startTasks|[[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoNextTask](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotonexttask)]|false|none|Set of tasks numbers from where the workflow execution is started by this trigger. If this is empty, then workflow is executed with default start tasks. In the list of start tasks, none of two tasks can have direct ancestor-descendant relationships (i.e. in a same workflow execution graph).|
|triggerCriteria|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoTriggerCriteria](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprototriggercriteria)|false|none|Optional. When set, Eventbus will run the task specified in the trigger_criteria and validate the result using the trigger_criteria.condition, and only execute the workflow when result is true.|
|triggerId|string|false|none|The backend trigger ID.|
|triggerNumber|string|false|none|Required. A number to uniquely identify each trigger config within the workflow on UI.|
|triggerType|string|false|none|none|

Identifies whether a field contains, or may contain, PII or sensitive data, and how to sanitize the field if it does. If a field's privacy type cannot be determined then it is sanitized (e.g., scrubbed). The specific sanitizer implementation is determined by run-time configuration and environment options (e.g., prod vs. qa). next_id: 5

Connection represents an instance of connector.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authConfig|[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1AuthConfig](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1authconfig)|false|none|Optional. Configuration for establishing the connection's authentication with an external system.|
|configVariables|[[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1ConfigVariable](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1configvariable)]|false|none|Optional. Configuration for configuring the connection with an external system.|
|connectorVersion|string|false|none|Required. Connector version on which the connection is created. The format is: projects/*/locations/*/providers/*/connectors/*/versions/* Only global location is supported for ConnectorVersion resource.|
|createTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Created time.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional. Description of the resource.|
|destinationConfigs|[[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1DestinationConfig](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1destinationconfig)]|false|none|Optional. Configuration of the Connector's destination. Only accepted for Connectors that accepts user defined destination(s).|
|envoyImageLocation|string|false|read-only|Output only. GCR location where the envoy image is stored. formatted like: gcr.io/{bucketName}/{imageName}|
|imageLocation|string|false|read-only|Output only. GCR location where the runtime image is stored. formatted like: gcr.io/{bucketName}/{imageName}|
|labels|object|false|none|Optional. Resource labels to represent user-provided metadata. Refer to cloud documentation on labels for more details. https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/labeling-resources|
|lockConfig|[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1LockConfig](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1lockconfig)|false|none|Optional. Configuration that indicates whether or not the Connection can be edited.|
|logConfig|[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1LogConfig](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1logconfig)|false|none|Optional. Log configuration for the connection.|
|name|string|false|read-only|Output only. Resource name of the Connection. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/connections/{connection}|
|nodeConfig|[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1NodeConfig](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1nodeconfig)|false|none|Optional. Node configuration for the connection.|
|serviceAccount|string|false|none|Optional. Service account needed for runtime plane to access GCP resources.|
|serviceDirectory|string|false|read-only|Output only. The name of the Service Directory service name. Used for Private Harpoon to resolve the ILB address. e.g. "projects/cloud-connectors-e2e-testing/locations/us-central1/namespaces/istio-system/services/istio-ingressgateway-connectors"|
|sslConfig|[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1SslConfig](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1sslconfig)|false|none|Optional. Ssl config of a connection|
|status|[GoogleCloudConnectorsV1ConnectionStatus](#schemagooglecloudconnectorsv1connectionstatus)|false|none|Output only. Current status of the connection.|
|suspended|boolean|false|none|Optional. Suspended indicates if a user has suspended a connection or not.|
|updateTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Updated time.|

|creatorEmail|string|false|none|The creator's email address. Generated based on the End User Credentials/LOAS role of the user making the call.|

|description|string|false|none|A description of the auth config.|
|displayName|string|false|none|The name of the auth config.|
|encryptedCredential|string(byte)|false|none|Auth credential encrypted by Cloud KMS. Can be decrypted as Credential with proper KMS key.|
|expiryNotificationDuration|[string(google-duration)]|false|none|User can define the time to receive notification after which the auth config becomes invalid. Support up to 30 days. Support granularity in hours.|
|lastModifierEmail|string|false|none|The last modifier's email address. Generated based on the End User Credentials/LOAS role of the user making the call.|
|name|string|false|none|Resource name of the SFDC instance projects/{project}/locations/{location}/authConfigs/{authConfig}.|
|overrideValidTime|string(google-datetime)|false|none|User provided expiry time to override. For the example of Salesforce, username/password credentials can be valid for 6 months depending on the instance settings.|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason / details of the current status.|
|state|string|false|none|The status of the auth config.|
|updateTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. The timestamp when the auth config is modified.|
|validTime|string(google-datetime)|false|none|The time until the auth config is valid. Empty or max value is considered the auth config won't expire.|
|visibility|string|false|none|The visibility of the auth config.|

<h2 id="tocS_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaCloudKmsConfig">GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaCloudKmsConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphacloudkmsconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaCloudKmsConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphacloudkmsconfig"></a>
<a id="tocsgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphacloudkmsconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "keyVersion": "string",
  "kmsLocation": "string",
  "kmsProjectId": "string",
  "kmsRing": "string"
}
```

Configuration information for Client's Cloud KMS information

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|string|false|none|Required. A Cloud KMS key is a named object containing one or more key versions, along with metadata for the key. A key exists on exactly one key ring tied to a specific location.|
|keyVersion|string|false|none|Optional. Each version of a key contains key material used for encryption or signing. A key's version is represented by an integer, starting at 1. To decrypt data or verify a signature, you must use the same key version that was used to encrypt or sign the data.|
|kmsLocation|string|false|none|Required. Location name of the key ring, e.g. "us-west1".|
|kmsProjectId|string|false|none|Optional. The gcp project id of the project where the kms key stored. If empty, the kms key is stored at the same project as customer's project and ecrypted with CMEK, otherwise, the kms key is stored in the tenant project and encrypted with GMEK|
|kmsRing|string|false|none|Required. A key ring organizes keys in a specific Google Cloud location and allows you to manage access control on groups of keys. A key ring's name does not need to be unique across a Google Cloud project, but must be unique within a given location.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|doNotPropagateError|boolean|false|none|Optional. Flag to determine how to should propagate errors. If this flag is set to be true, it will not throw an exception. Instead, it will return a {@link ExecuteIntegrationsResponse} with an execution id and error messages as PostWithTriggerIdExecutionException in {@link EventParameters}. The flag is set to be false by default.|
|executionId|string|false|none|Optional. The id of the ON_HOLD execution to be resumed.|
|inputParameters|object|false|none|Optional. Input parameters used by integration execution.|
|parameterEntries|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoParameterEntry](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoparameterentry)]|false|none|Optional. Parameters are a part of Event and can be used to communicate between different tasks that are part of the same integration execution.|
|parameters|[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoEventParameters](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoeventparameters)|false|none|Optional. Passed in as parameters to each integration execution. Redacted|
|requestId|string|false|none|Optional. This is used to de-dup incoming request: if the duplicate request was detected, the response from the previous execution is returned.|
|triggerId|string|false|none|Required. Matched against all {@link TriggerConfig}s across all integrations. i.e. TriggerConfig.trigger_id.equals(trigger_id). The trigger_id is in the format of `api_trigger/TRIGGER_NAME`.|

The Execution resource contains detailed information of an individual integration execution.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Created time of the execution.|
|directSubExecutions|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaExecution](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaexecution)]|false|none|Direct sub executions of the following Execution.|
|eventExecutionDetails|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoEventExecutionDetails](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotoeventexecutiondetails)|false|none|The execution info about this event.|
|executionDetails|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaExecutionDetails](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaexecutiondetails)|false|none|Detailed info of this execution.|
|executionMethod|string|false|none|The ways user posts this event.|
|name|string|false|none|Auto-generated primary key.|
|requestParameters|object|false|none|Event parameters come in as part of the request.|
|requestParams|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoParameterEntry](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoparameterentry)]|false|none|Event parameters come in as part of the request.|
|responseParameters|object|false|none|Event parameters returned as part of the response.|
|responseParams|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoParameterEntry](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoparameterentry)]|false|none|Event parameters come out as part of the response.|
|triggerId|string|false|none|The trigger id of the integration trigger config. If both trigger_id and client_id is present, the integration is executed from the start tasks provided by the matching trigger config otherwise it is executed from the default start tasks.|
|updateTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Last modified time of the execution.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|executionMethod|EXECUTION_METHOD_UNSPECIFIED|
|executionMethod|POST|
|executionMethod|POST_TO_QUEUE|
|executionMethod|SCHEDULE|

<a id="tocsgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphafailurepolicy"></a>

```json
{
  "intervalTime": "string",
  "maxRetries": 0,
  "retryStrategy": "RETRY_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED"
}
```

Policy that defines the task retry logic and failure type. If no FailurePolicy is defined for a task, all its dependent tasks will not be executed (i.e, a `retry_strategy` of NONE will be applied).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|intervalTime|string(google-datetime)|false|none|Required if retry_strategy is FIXED_INTERVAL or LINEAR/EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF/RESTART_INTEGRATION_WITH_BACKOFF. Defines the initial interval in seconds for backoff.|
|maxRetries|integer(int32)|false|none|Required if retry_strategy is FIXED_INTERVAL or LINEAR/EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF/RESTART_INTEGRATION_WITH_BACKOFF. Defines the number of times the task will be retried if failed.|
|retryStrategy|string|false|none|Defines what happens to the task upon failure.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|retryStrategy|RETRY_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED|
|retryStrategy|IGNORE|
|retryStrategy|NONE|
|retryStrategy|FATAL|
|retryStrategy|FIXED_INTERVAL|
|retryStrategy|LINEAR_BACKOFF|
|retryStrategy|EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF|
|retryStrategy|RESTART_INTEGRATION_WITH_BACKOFF|

<h2 id="tocS_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfig">GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfig"></a>
<a id="tocsgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "aggregationPeriod": "string",
  "alertThreshold": 0,
  "disableAlert": true,
  "displayName": "string",
  "durationThreshold": "string",
  "metricType": "METRIC_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "onlyFinalAttempt": true,
  "thresholdType": "THRESHOLD_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED",
  "thresholdValue": {
    "absolute": "string",
    "percentage": 0
  }
}
```

Message to be used to configure custom alerting in the {@code EventConfig} protos for an event.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|aggregationPeriod|string|false|none|The period over which the metric value should be aggregated and evaluated. Format is , where integer should be a positive integer and unit should be one of (s,m,h,d,w) meaning (second, minute, hour, day, week). For an EXPECTED_MIN threshold, this aggregation_period must be lesser than 24 hours.|
|alertThreshold|integer(int32)|false|none|For how many contiguous aggregation periods should the expected min or max be violated for the alert to be fired.|
|disableAlert|boolean|false|none|Set to false by default. When set to true, the metrics are not aggregated or pushed to Monarch for this integration alert.|
|displayName|string|false|none|Name of the alert. This will be displayed in the alert subject. If set, this name should be unique within the scope of the integration.|
|durationThreshold|string(google-duration)|false|none|Should be specified only for *AVERAGE_DURATION and *PERCENTILE_DURATION metrics. This member should be used to specify what duration value the metrics should exceed for the alert to trigger.|
|metricType|string|false|none|The type of metric.|
|onlyFinalAttempt|boolean|false|none|For either events or tasks, depending on the type of alert, count only final attempts, not retries.|
|thresholdType|string|false|none|The threshold type, whether lower(expected_min) or upper(expected_max), for which this alert is being configured. If value falls below expected_min or exceeds expected_max, an alert will be fired.|
|thresholdValue|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfigThresholdValue](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfigthresholdvalue)|false|none|The metric value, above or below which the alert should be triggered.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|metricType|METRIC_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|metricType|EVENT_ERROR_RATE|
|metricType|EVENT_WARNING_RATE|
|metricType|TASK_ERROR_RATE|
|metricType|TASK_WARNING_RATE|
|metricType|TASK_RATE|
|metricType|EVENT_RATE|
|metricType|EVENT_AVERAGE_DURATION|
|metricType|EVENT_PERCENTILE_DURATION|
|metricType|TASK_AVERAGE_DURATION|
|metricType|TASK_PERCENTILE_DURATION|
|thresholdType|THRESHOLD_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|thresholdType|EXPECTED_MIN|
|thresholdType|EXPECTED_MAX|

<h2 id="tocS_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfigThresholdValue">GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfigThresholdValue</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfigthresholdvalue"></a>
<a id="schema_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfigThresholdValue"></a>
<a id="tocSgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfigthresholdvalue"></a>
<a id="tocsgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfigthresholdvalue"></a>

```json
{
  "absolute": "string",
  "percentage": 0
}
```

The threshold value of the metric, above or below which the alert should be triggered. See EventAlertConfig or TaskAlertConfig for the different alert metric types in each case. For the *RATE metrics, one or both of these fields may be set. Zero is the default value and can be left at that. For *PERCENTILE_DURATION metrics, one or both of these fields may be set, and also, the duration threshold value should be specified in the threshold_duration_ms member below. For *AVERAGE_DURATION metrics, these fields should not be set at all. A different member, threshold_duration_ms, must be set in the EventAlertConfig or the TaskAlertConfig.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|absolute|string(int64)|false|none|Absolute value threshold.|
|percentage|integer(int32)|false|none|Percentage threshold.|

Integration Parameter is defined in the integration config and are used to provide information about data types of the expected parameters and provide any default values if needed. They can also be used to add custom attributes. These are static in nature and should not be used for dynamic event definition.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|dataType|string|false|none|Type of the parameter.|
|defaultValue|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaValueType](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphavaluetype)|false|none|Default values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message or a serialized object.|
|displayName|string|false|none|The name (without prefix) to be displayed in the UI for this parameter. E.g. if the key is "foo.bar.myName", then the name would be "myName".|
|inputOutputType|string|false|none|Specifies the input/output type for the parameter.|
|isTransient|boolean|false|none|Whether this parameter is a transient parameter.|
|jsonSchema|string|false|none|This schema will be used to validate runtime JSON-typed values of this parameter.|
|key|string|false|none|Key is used to retrieve the corresponding parameter value. This should be unique for a given fired event. These parameters must be predefined in the integration definition.|
|producer|string|false|none|The identifier of the node (TaskConfig/TriggerConfig) this parameter was produced by, if it is a transient param or a copy of an input param.|
|searchable|boolean|false|none|Searchable in the execution log or not.|

The integration version definition.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Auto-generated.|
|databasePersistencePolicy|string|false|none|Optional. Flag to disable database persistence for execution data, including event execution info, execution export info, execution metadata index and execution param index.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional. The integration description.|
|errorCatcherConfigs|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaErrorCatcherConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaerrorcatcherconfig)]|false|none|Optional. Error Catch Task configuration for the integration. It's optional.|
|integrationParameters|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationParameter](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationparameter)]|false|none|Optional. Parameters that are expected to be passed to the integration when an event is triggered. This consists of all the parameters that are expected in the integration execution. This gives the user the ability to provide default values, add information like PII and also provide data types of each parameter.|
|integrationParametersInternal|[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoWorkflowParameters](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoworkflowparameters)|false|none|Optional. Parameters that are expected to be passed to the integration when an event is triggered. This consists of all the parameters that are expected in the integration execution. This gives the user the ability to provide default values, add information like PII and also provide data types of each parameter.|
|lastModifierEmail|string|false|none|Optional. The last modifier's email address. Generated based on the End User Credentials/LOAS role of the user making the call.|
|lockHolder|string|false|none|Optional. The edit lock holder's email address. Generated based on the End User Credentials/LOAS role of the user making the call.|
|name|string|false|read-only|Output only. Auto-generated primary key.|
|origin|string|false|none|Optional. The origin that indicates where this integration is coming from.|
|parentTemplateId|string|false|none|Optional. The id of the template which was used to create this integration_version.|
|runAsServiceAccount|string|false|none|Optional. The run-as service account email, if set and auth config is not configured, that will be used to generate auth token to be used in Connector task, Rest caller task and Cloud function task.|
|snapshotNumber|string(int64)|false|none|Optional. An increasing sequence that is set when a new snapshot is created. The last created snapshot can be identified by [workflow_name, org_id latest(snapshot_number)]. However, last created snapshot need not be same as the HEAD. So users should always use "HEAD" tag to identify the head.|
|state|string|false|read-only|Output only. User should not set it as an input.|
|status|string|false|read-only|Output only. Generated by eventbus. User should not set it as an input.|
|taskConfigs|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaTaskConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphataskconfig)]|false|none|Optional. Task configuration for the integration. It's optional, but the integration doesn't do anything without task_configs.|
|taskConfigsInternal|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoTaskConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprototaskconfig)]|false|none|Optional. Task configuration for the integration. It's optional, but the integration doesn't do anything without task_configs.|
|teardown|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoTeardown](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprototeardown)|false|none|Optional. Contains a graph of tasks that will be executed before putting the event in a terminal state (SUCCEEDED/FAILED/FATAL), regardless of success or failure, similar to "finally" in code.|
|triggerConfigs|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaTriggerConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphatriggerconfig)]|false|none|Optional. Trigger configurations.|
|triggerConfigsInternal|[[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoTriggerConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprototriggerconfig)]|false|none|Optional. Trigger configurations.|
|updateTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Auto-generated.|
|userLabel|string|false|none|Optional. A user-defined label that annotates an integration version. Typically, this is only set when the integration version is created.|

<h2 id="tocS_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaJwt">GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaJwt</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphajwt"></a>
<a id="schema_GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaJwt"></a>
<a id="tocSgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphajwt"></a>
<a id="tocsgooglecloudintegrationsv1alphajwt"></a>

```json
{
  "jwt": "string",
  "jwtHeader": "string",
  "jwtPayload": "string",
  "secret": "string"
}
```

Represents JSON web token(JWT), which is a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties, enabling the claims to be digitally signed or integrity protected.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|jwt|string|false|none|The token calculated by the header, payload and signature.|
|jwtHeader|string|false|none|Identifies which algorithm is used to generate the signature.|
|jwtPayload|string|false|none|Contains a set of claims. The JWT specification defines seven Registered Claim Names which are the standard fields commonly included in tokens. Custom claims are usually also included, depending on the purpose of the token.|
|secret|string|false|none|User's pre-shared secret to sign the token.|

The OAuth Type where the client sends request with the client id and requested scopes to auth endpoint. User sees a consent screen and auth code is received at specified redirect url afterwards. The auth code is then combined with the client id and secret and sent to the token endpoint in exchange for the access and refresh token. The refresh token can be used to fetch new access tokens.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accessToken|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaAccessToken](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaaccesstoken)|false|none|The access token received from the token endpoint.|
|applyReauthPolicy|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the user has opted in Google Reauth Policy. If opted in, the refresh token will be valid for 20 hours, after which time users must re-authenticate in order to obtain a new one.|
|authCode|string|false|none|The Auth Code that is used to initially retrieve the access token.|
|authEndpoint|string|false|none|The auth url endpoint to send the auth code request to.|
|authParams|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaParameterMap](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaparametermap)|false|none|The auth parameters sent along with the auth code request.|
|clientId|string|false|none|The client's id.|
|clientSecret|string|false|none|The client's secret.|
|requestType|string|false|none|Represent how to pass parameters to fetch access token|
|scope|string|false|none|A space-delimited list of requested scope permissions.|
|tokenEndpoint|string|false|none|The token url endpoint to send the token request to.|
|tokenParams|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaParameterMap](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaparametermap)|false|none|The token parameters sent along with the token request.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|requestType|REQUEST_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|requestType|REQUEST_BODY|
|requestType|QUERY_PARAMETERS|
|requestType|ENCODED_HEADER|

The SfdcInstance resource use to hold channels and connection config data.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authConfigId|[string]|false|none|A list of AuthConfigs that can be tried to open the channel to SFDC|
|createTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Time when the instance is created|
|deleteTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Time when the instance was deleted. Empty if not deleted.|
|description|string|false|none|A description of the sfdc instance.|
|displayName|string|false|none|User selected unique name/alias to easily reference an instance.|
|name|string|false|none|Resource name of the SFDC instance projects/{project}/locations/{location}/sfdcInstances/{sfdcInstance}.|
|serviceAuthority|string|false|none|URL used for API calls after authentication (the login authority is configured within the referenced AuthConfig).|
|sfdcOrgId|string|false|none|The SFDC Org Id. This is defined in salesforce.|
|updateTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Time when the instance was last updated|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|createTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Auto-generated.|
|eventExecutionInfoId|string|false|none|Required. ID of the associated execution.|
|integration|string|false|none|Required. The name of the originating integration.|
|lastModifyTime|string(google-datetime)|false|read-only|Output only. Auto-generated.|
|name|string|false|none|Resource name for suspensions suspension/{suspension_id}|
|state|string|false|none|Required. State of this suspension, indicating what action a resolver has taken.|
|suspensionConfig|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoSuspensionConfig](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotosuspensionconfig)|false|none|Controls the notifications and resolver permissions for this suspension.|
|taskId|string|false|none|Required. Task id of the associated SuspensionTask.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|RESOLUTION_STATE_UNSPECIFIED|
|state|PENDING|

|state|LIFTED|

The task configuration details. This is not the implementation of Task. There might be multiple TaskConfigs for the same Task.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string|false|none|Optional. User-provided description intended to give additional business context about the task.|
|displayName|string|false|none|Optional. User-provided label that is attached to this TaskConfig in the UI.|
|errorCatcherId|string|false|none|Optional. Optional Error catcher id of the error catch flow which will be executed when execution error happens in the task|
|externalTaskType|string|false|none|Optional. External task type of the task|
|failurePolicy|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaFailurePolicy](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphafailurepolicy)|false|none|Optional. Determines the number of times the task will be retried on failure and with what retry strategy. This is applicable for asynchronous calls to Eventbus alone (Post To Queue, Schedule etc.).|
|jsonValidationOption|string|false|none|Optional. If set, overrides the option configured in the Task implementation class.|
|nextTasks|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaNextTask](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphanexttask)]|false|none|Optional. The set of tasks that are next in line to be executed as per the execution graph defined for the parent event, specified by `event_config_id`. Each of these next tasks are executed only if the condition associated with them evaluates to true.|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|string|false|none|Optional. The policy dictating the execution of the next set of tasks for the current task.|
|parameters|object|false|none|Optional. The customized parameters the user can pass to this task.|
|position|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaCoordinate](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphacoordinate)|false|none|Optional. Informs the front-end application where to draw this error catcher config on the UI.|
|successPolicy|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaSuccessPolicy](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphasuccesspolicy)|false|none|Optional. Determines what action to take upon successful task completion.|
|synchronousCallFailurePolicy|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaFailurePolicy](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphafailurepolicy)|false|none|Optional. Determines the number of times the task will be retried on failure and with what retry strategy. This is applicable for synchronous calls to Eventbus alone (Post).|
|task|string|false|none|Optional. The name for the task.|
|taskExecutionStrategy|string|false|none|Optional. The policy dictating the execution strategy of this task.|
|taskId|string|false|none|Required. The identifier of this task within its parent event config, specified by the client. This should be unique among all the tasks belong to the same event config. We use this field as the identifier to find next tasks (via field `next_tasks.task_id`).|
|taskTemplate|string|false|none|Optional. Used to define task-template name if task is of type task-template|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|externalTaskType|EXTERNAL_TASK_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|externalTaskType|NORMAL_TASK|
|externalTaskType|ERROR_TASK|
|jsonValidationOption|JSON_VALIDATION_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED|
|jsonValidationOption|SKIP|
|jsonValidationOption|PRE_EXECUTION|
|jsonValidationOption|POST_EXECUTION|
|jsonValidationOption|PRE_POST_EXECUTION|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|NEXT_TASKS_EXECUTION_POLICY_UNSPECIFIED|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|RUN_ALL_MATCH|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|RUN_FIRST_MATCH|
|taskExecutionStrategy|TASK_EXECUTION_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED|
|taskExecutionStrategy|WHEN_ALL_SUCCEED|
|taskExecutionStrategy|WHEN_ANY_SUCCEED|
|taskExecutionStrategy|WHEN_ALL_TASKS_AND_CONDITIONS_SUCCEED|


The request for testing an integration.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|clientId|string|false|none|Required. This is used to identify the client on whose behalf the event will be executed.|
|deadlineSecondsTime|string(google-datetime)|false|none|Optional. custom deadline of the rpc|
|inputParameters|object|false|none|Optional. Input parameters used during integration execution.|
|integrationVersion|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationVersion](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationversion)|false|none|Required. integration config to execute the workflow|
|parameters|[EnterpriseCrmFrontendsEventbusProtoEventParameters](#schemaenterprisecrmfrontendseventbusprotoeventparameters)|false|none|Optional. Passed in as parameters to each integration execution.|
|testMode|boolean|false|none|Optional. Can be specified in the event request, otherwise false (default). If true, enables tasks with condition "test_mode = true". If false, disables tasks with condition "test_mode = true" if global test mode (set by platform) is also false {@link EventBusConfig}.|
|triggerId|string|false|none|Required. The trigger id of the integration trigger config. If both trigger_id and client_id is present, the integration is executed from the start tasks provided by the matching trigger config otherwise it is executed from the default start tasks.|

Configuration detail of a trigger.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alertConfig|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaIntegrationAlertConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphaintegrationalertconfig)]|false|none|Optional. An alert threshold configuration for the [trigger + client + integration] tuple. If these values are not specified in the trigger config, default values will be populated by the system. Note that there must be exactly one alert threshold configured per [client + trigger + integration] when published.|
|cloudSchedulerConfig|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaCloudSchedulerConfig](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphacloudschedulerconfig)|false|none|Optional. Cloud Scheduler Trigger related metadata|
|description|string|false|none|Optional. User-provided description intended to give additional business context about the task.|
|errorCatcherId|string|false|none|Optional. Optional Error catcher id of the error catch flow which will be executed when execution error happens in the task|
|label|string|false|none|Optional. The user created label for a particular trigger.|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|string|false|none|Optional. Dictates how next tasks will be executed.|
|position|[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaCoordinate](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphacoordinate)|false|none|Optional. Informs the front-end application where to draw this error catcher config on the UI.|
|properties|object|false|none|Optional. Configurable properties of the trigger, not to be confused with integration parameters. E.g. "name" is a property for API triggers and "subscription" is a property for Pub/sub triggers.|
|startTasks|[[GoogleCloudIntegrationsV1alphaNextTask](#schemagooglecloudintegrationsv1alphanexttask)]|false|none|Optional. Set of tasks numbers from where the integration execution is started by this trigger. If this is empty, then integration is executed with default start tasks. In the list of start tasks, none of two tasks can have direct ancestor-descendant relationships (i.e. in a same integration execution graph).|
|triggerId|string|false|none|Optional. The backend trigger ID.|
|triggerNumber|string|false|none|Required. A number to uniquely identify each trigger config within the integration on UI.|
|triggerType|string|false|none|Optional. Type of trigger|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|NEXT_TASKS_EXECUTION_POLICY_UNSPECIFIED|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|RUN_ALL_MATCH|
|nextTasksExecutionPolicy|RUN_FIRST_MATCH|
|triggerType|TRIGGER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED|
|triggerType|CRON|
|triggerType|API|
|triggerType|SFDC_CHANNEL|
|triggerType|CLOUD_PUBSUB_EXTERNAL|
|triggerType|SFDC_CDC_CHANNEL|
|triggerType|CLOUD_SCHEDULER|

Use this request to post all workflows associated with a given trigger id. Next available id: 10

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|clientId|string|false|none|Optional. If the client id is provided, then the combination of trigger id and client id is matched across all the workflows. If the client id is not provided, then workflows with matching trigger id are executed for each client id in the {@link TriggerConfig}. For Api Trigger, the client id is required and will be validated against the allowed clients.|
|ignoreErrorIfNoActiveWorkflow|boolean|false|none|Optional. Flag to determine whether clients would suppress a warning when no ACTIVE workflows are not found. If this flag is set to be true, an error will not be thrown if the requested trigger_id or client_id is not found in any ACTIVE workflow. Otherwise, the error is always thrown. The flag is set to be false by default.|
|parameters|[EnterpriseCrmEventbusProtoEventParameters](#schemaenterprisecrmeventbusprotoeventparameters)|false|none|Passed in as parameters to each workflow execution. Optional.|
|priority|string|false|none|The request priority this request should be processed at. For internal users:|
|requestId|string|false|none|Optional. This is used to de-dup incoming request: if the duplicate request was detected, the response from the previous execution is returned. Must have no more than 36 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.|
|scheduledTime|string(int64)|false|none|Optional. Time in milliseconds since epoch when the given event would be scheduled.|
|testMode|boolean|false|none|Optional. Sets test mode in {@link enterprise/crm/eventbus/event_message.proto}.|
|triggerId|string|false|none|Matched against all {@link TriggerConfig}s across all workflows. i.e. TriggerConfig.trigger_id.equals(trigger_id) Required.|
|workflowName|string|false|none|Optional. If provided, the workflow_name is used to filter all the matched workflows having same trigger_id+client_id. A combination of trigger_id, client_id and workflow_name identifies a unique workflow.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|priority|UNSPCIFIED|
|priority|SHEDDABLE|
|priority|SHEDDABLE_PLUS|
|priority|CRITICAL|
|priority|CRITICAL_PLUS|
